scope: Publication consistency and mechanical code counts. No claim of LMX execution, adapter guarantees, XLSX formula evaluation or PDF visual QA.

method.nonwhitespace_characters: Unicode code points for which str.isspace() is false; comments and string literals are included
method.utf8_bytes: len(canonical_source.encode('utf-8')) including spaces and the final LF
method.csv: UTF-8 BOM required; *_utf8_bytes columns are checked if present, otherwise bytes remain in this report
method.procedural_originals: Only materially different current approaches are retained in optional variant metadata. Any retained source must match its publication and declared full context; it is excluded from primary counts. Minor or obsolete duplicates may be removed and explained in notes. The primary is shortest among eligible variants with the same observed contract and counting boundary.
